# UI Primitives & Styling

1. **Primitive Composition.** Build complex UIs by composing small, single-purpose primitives from `packages/ui`.

2. **Theme Consistency.** Use CSS variables and Tailwind v4 theme tokens (`--color-void`, `--color-biolum`). Avoid hardcoded hex/rgb values.

3. **Purity.** Components should be pure functions. Isolate side effects in custom hooks.

4. **Accessibility.** Every interactive component must expose ARIA roles and support keyboard navigation.
